goal: Systematically refactor server code, contract auditing, test suite, and AGENTS.md to permanently eliminate client-server desync and blind spot regressions.

Implement tests/test_e2e_server.py testing live HTTP endpoints, asset proxies, and full-stack integration
Update AGENTS.md with Section 9: Full-Stack Consumer Contract Verification Standard and Learned Invariant rules
Verify all gates (contract audit, e2e suite, ruff) and commit
